name: agent-bench
description: Private benchmark harness: does an agent work a Markdown knowledge base better through omgbase (the full MCP tool catalog or the minimal profile) or through generic filesystem tools over the same vault? Drives Claude through `omg mcp` over stdio, or an in-process file-tool server, on fresh copies of two corpora — the shared alchemy fixture and a generated 348-note programme timeline — and scores machine-checkable end states and answers through omgbase. Private, unpublished.
